in_latin.name: Silvija
in_latin.meaning: שמלת היער, אטריוס, מי שגדלה ביער
in_latin.long_meaning: Silvija est nomen femininum, quod oritur a silva, quae est locus habitationis. In antiquis temporibus, nomen huius Silvijae significabat spectacula futura, et sicut arbores, multa spectacula fuerunt. Hoc nomen in libro de origine gentium (Yohsina, 34:11) reperi, et in aetate Byzantina, orthodoxi dabant filiabus suas 'Silvijae', quod erat titulus 'arborem', et repraesentabat hominem, qui in mundo, sicut arbor, operatio sua, stabilitur et non regitur.

in_english.name: Silvija
in_english.meaning: Lady of the Forest, name of Atrides, one who grew up in the forest
in_english.long_meaning: Silvija is a female given name with roots in Latin, originating from the word silva, referring to forest. Its role in ancient times was to represent the vision of the future, and like trees, many visions were. The name is found in the Book of Genesis (Yohsina, 34:11), and in the Byzantine era, Orthodox gave to their daughters 'Silvija', a title 'arborem', representing a person whose activity in the world, like a tree, is constant and not governed. It also symbolizes strength, resilience, and the ability to thrive in challenging circumstances.
